alt: A PNG exported from the Microservices starter: connector captions, the shared routes-to label and the note chip sit where the canvas shows them.
An agent-drawn Storefront in the desktop app: inside the system, the web app, Catalog and Orders APIs, cache and stores, laid out in request order.
A connector from Storefront to Orders API bent over the top, with its options open: the Route row offers straight, stepped and curved, and Reset route beside them.
